name: @pk-nerdsaver-ai/collab-relay
description: Owned Cloudflare relay and share service for OMP collaboration

scripts.build:client: rm -rf dist && bun build ../collab-web/index.html --outdir=dist --minify --entry-naming=[hash].[ext] --chunk-naming=[hash].[ext] --asset-naming=[hash].[ext] && mv dist/*.html dist/index.html && cp -R ../collab-web/public/* dist/ && bun scripts/generate-csp.ts dist
scripts.build: bun run build:client && mkdir -p dist/share-viewer && bun ../coding-agent/scripts/generate-share-viewer.ts dist/share-viewer/index.html && bun scripts/verify-build.ts dist
scripts.check: biome check src test scripts && bun run check:types
scripts.test: bun test test && bun run build
